title: Reduction time bound
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean symbols, natural numbers $d,c$, a deterministic Turing machine $V$ over Booleans, and natural numbers $CV,cV$, define the time bound at input length $n$ to be $CV igl(3wCoef(N,d)^2+3wCoef(N,d)+3 igr)^{cV}(n+1)^{2(c+1)cV}+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a nondeterministic Turing machine over Booleans
$V$ is a deterministic Turing machine over Booleans
